name: sidecar-wake
description: Wake Island co-op with two bots and a long round: the target for the UDP sidecar POC (features/udp-sidecar), which joins with a script rather than the game. Few bots so the server loads fast and the join is easy to read in its event log.
human: No client: `node tools/bf1942-models/sidecar/join.mjs 127.0.0.1:14568` joins. `lab.py status` should list it as a player; `lab.py stop` collects the event log.
